name: Riverside Golf Club
_comment_tees: Scorecard from GolfPass (2972); its pars match OpenStreetMap's hole tags. Men's ratings; Red is rated for women only.
_comment_shift: OSM outlines sit this many metres off the Esri imagery (measured by fitting all bunkers to the sand); every point is moved by it.
_comment_drop: Polygons containing these points are not part of the course (two practice greens; four bunkers OSM draws on grass, where the imagery has none; seven ponds and river reaches outside the course boundary).
_comment_pinAtLineEnd: #13 and #18 share one big double green: their pins are the ends of their own hole lines, not its middle.
